description: Issue 3 — route hardcoded Filipino strings through i18n so selecting English fully switches the UI. Dictionaries are already at key parity (en=fil=624, munEn=munFil=392); the gap is hardcoded Filipino in components that never call t(). Fix AlertBanner, WeatherCard, WeatherPanel, ProjectTracker. Do NOT touch ChatWidget/EmbedCard (they already have working {fil,en} maps) or ForecastStrip (already language-aware). Runs after FEAT-002 because it also edits AlertBanner.tsx.
steps: Add new base-dictionary keys to BOTH src/lib/i18n/fil.ts and src/lib/i18n/en.ts (exact parity required or the Record<ITranslationKey,string> typing fails the build): alert.affectedAreas (with {areas} var), alert.call911, alert.dismiss, alert.dismissLabel; weather.searchPrompt, weather.sourcePagasa, weather.sourceOpenMeteo, weather.heavyRain, weather.umbrella, weather.humidity, weather.rainChance, weather.wind, weather.feelsLike, weather.updatedAt (with {time} var); transparency.projectsTitle (with {place} var), transparency.projectsPlaceFallback, transparency.subtitle, transparency.demoBadge, transparency.filterAllBarangay, transparency.filterAllStatus, transparency.totalBudget, transparency.emptyTitle, transparency.emptyHint, transparency.loadError. Filipino values = the current hardcoded strings; English values = natural translations.

In src/components/alerts/AlertBanner.tsx, call useLanguage().t and replace 'Apektadong lugar: ...' -> t('alert.affectedAreas', { areas }), 'Tawagan ang 911' -> t('alert.call911'), 'Isara' -> t('alert.dismiss'), aria-label 'Isara ang alerto' -> t('alert.dismissLabel'). Preserve the FEAT-002 pathname guard and layout fixes.

In src/components/weather/WeatherCard.tsx, add 'use client' and useLanguage(); replace attribution ('Ayon sa PAGASA'/'Ayon sa Open-Meteo') with t('weather.sourcePagasa')/t('weather.sourceOpenMeteo'), the heavy-rain/umbrella banners, the four dt labels (Halumigmig/Tsansa ng ulan/Hangin/Pakiramdam) and 'Kuha noong {time}' -> t('weather.updatedAt', { time }). Pass language into formatManilaTime so the Intl locale is 'en-PH' when English, 'fil-PH' when Filipino.
In src/components/weather/WeatherPanel.tsx, use useLanguage().t and replace 'Maghanap ng lokasyon para makita ang panahon.' -> t('weather.searchPrompt').

In src/components/transparency/ProjectTracker.tsx, use useLanguage().t and replace the hardcoded header title, subtitle, demo badge, filter option labels ('Lahat ng barangay'/'Lahat ng kalagayan'), 'Kabuuang badyet', the empty-state title/hint, and the LOAD_ERROR constant with the transparency.* keys (convert LOAD_ERROR usages to t('transparency.loadError')).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint ; npm run build` both exit 0 (green build proves fil/en key parity).
Toggling EN on / switches the weather card labels/attribution, the umbrella/heavy-rain warnings, and the location search prompt to English.
Toggling EN on /transparency switches the ProjectTracker header, filters, totals, empty state and load error to English.
Toggling EN shows the hazard banner's affected-area line, 911 button and dismiss control in English. Filipino remains the default.
verification: Run `npm run lint ; npm run build` (PowerShell) and confirm both exit 0.
findings: Added 23 new base-dictionary keys to BOTH src/lib/i18n/fil.ts and src/lib/i18n/en.ts at exact parity (green build confirms the Record<ITranslationKey,string> typing holds). New keys: alert.affectedAreas ({areas}), alert.call911, alert.dismiss, alert.dismissLabel; weather.searchPrompt, weather.sourcePagasa, weather.sourceOpenMeteo, weather.heavyRain, weather.umbrella, weather.humidity, weather.rainChance, weather.wind, weather.feelsLike, weather.updatedAt ({time}); transparency.projectsTitle ({place}), transparency.projectsPlaceFallback, transparency.subtitle, transparency.demoBadge, transparency.filterAllBarangay, transparency.filterAllStatus, transparency.totalBudget, transparency.emptyTitle, transparency.emptyHint, transparency.loadError. Components routed through useLanguage().t: (1) AlertBanner.tsx — 'Apektadong lugar: ...'->t('alert.affectedAreas',{areas}), 'Tawagan ang 911'->t('alert.call911'), 'Isara'->t('alert.dismiss'), aria-label 'Isara ang alerto'->t('alert.dismissLabel'); FEAT-002 pathname guard (onDashboard suppression) and layout preserved. (2) WeatherCard.tsx — added 'use client' + useLanguage(); attribution now t('weather.sourcePagasa')/t('weather.sourceOpenMeteo'), heavy-rain/umbrella banners, the four dt labels, and 'Kuha noong {time}'->t('weather.updatedAt',{time}); formatManilaTime now takes language and uses Intl locale 'en-PH' for English, 'fil-PH' for Filipino. (3) WeatherPanel.tsx — 'Maghanap ng lokasyon...'->t('weather.searchPrompt'). (4) ProjectTracker.tsx — removed the LOAD_ERROR constant and routed both usages through t('transparency.loadError') (added t to the fetch effect's dep array; t is useCallback-memoized by language so it only re-runs on language change), plus header title/subtitle, demo badge, both filter 'Lahat ...' options, 'Kabuuang badyet', and the empty-state title/hint. Did NOT touch ChatWidget/EmbedCard/ForecastStrip. Out-of-scope hardcoded strings left as-is per the FEAT-003 boundary (WeatherPanel 'Subukan ulit' retry, ProjectTracker 'Subukan ulit' retry / 'Barangay'/'Kalagayan' field labels / 'Proyekto'/'Nailabas' stat labels / Intl 'fil-PH' peso formatter). Verification: `npm run lint ; npm run build` both exit 0 with no errors or warnings.
